project.name: sdlc
project.description:
SDLC automation sandbox (#849 - SDLC automation build plan, "sandboxed code-execution options for SDLC agent" research item #839). A new sibling module, not a rewrite of anything existing - same shape as "sarvam"/ "google": scaffold first (credential storage + a thin REST client over the sandbox provider's own API), agent-facing tool callbacks in a later stage once this foundation is proven, exactly the staged approach the SDLC automation scoping doc (#837) laid out.
Provider: E2B (https://api.e2b.app), chosen in research item #839 for its purpose-built "ephemeral VM per code-execution request" model over a hand-rolled Docker-in-Docker approach - see E2bSandboxClient's javadoc for the exact confirmed API surface and its one deliberately-unimplemented gap (command execution).
Stage 1 (this module's initial contents): module scaffold + encrypted credential storage (E2bCredential/E2bCredentialRepository/ E2bCredentialService/E2bApiException/E2bCredentialController) plus a real REST client for the two confirmed simple-REST E2B endpoints - create sandbox and kill sandbox (E2bSandboxClient) - wrapped by a thin SdlcSandboxService/SdlcSandboxController. Command/process execution inside a running sandbox is NOT implemented here: E2B's own API reference documents Sandboxes/Templates/Tags/Volumes as plain REST but Process (command execution) is served by envd, the per-sandbox agent, over its own RPC protocol on the sandbox's dedicated host - not something this scaffold can respond to with any confidence when the sandbox this codebase runs in has no working compiler to test such a client against. See E2bSandboxClient's javadoc for the honest, undodged statement of that gap.
Credential model: per-tenant BYOK, schema-scoped like SarvamCredential/ TwilioCredential/GoogleCredential - no tenant_id column needed, schema-per-tenant multi-tenancy already isolates it. Depends on: crypto (EncryptionService for the stored key), security (TenantContext, not used directly in Stage 1 but kept for parity with every sibling module in this position), tenancy (kept for the same reason).
